visual_elements.description: DECODER (inside yellow rounded rectangle). Three identical time-step columns, left to right. Each column, top to bottom: output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃ (italic serif, dark olive) at top; black upward arrow from a green cell to the label with italic 'softmax' label placed to the left of the arrow; a light-green rectangle divided into 3 equal segments (softmax/output layer); black downward arrow; a light-orange rectangle divided into 3 equal segments (RNN hidden cell). Horizontal black right-arrows connect the orange cells: first connector labeled s₁, second labeled s₂, and a third arrow exits the right edge of the third orange cell labeled s₃. Two thin black curved arrows swoop from beneath the s₁ and s₂ connectors, dip downward and curve up into the bottom edges of the second and third orange cells (recurrent feedback). A small solid red dot sits at the left edge of the first orange cell (context-vector entry point).

ENCODER (inside peach rounded rectangle). Top row: three pink/salmon rectangles each divided into 3 equal segments (RNN hidden cells), connected left to right by black arrows; first connector labeled h₁, second labeled h₂; a black arrow enters the first pink cell horizontally from the left edge of the container (unlabeled initial state); a small solid red dot sits at the right edge of the third pink cell. Bottom row: three tan rectangles each divided into 3 equal segments (input cells), one beneath each pink cell. Black upward arrows run from each tan cell to the pink cell above, each labeled to its left in italic dark-olive text: 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃'. At the very bottom, black upward arrows rise from the labels x₁, x₂, x₃ into each tan cell.

Context-vector connector: thin red curved arrow starting at the red dot on the right edge of the encoder's third pink cell, arcing upward and to the right, terminating with an arrowhead at the red dot on the left edge of the decoder's first orange cell.
